messages:
Sophie: Quick PSA — changelog cutoff in ~6h (12:00 UTC). Please add one-liners to the release notes template and tag the component. If PRs merge after cutoff we'll need backports.

Navin: Do we bump minor for the client config change in #3178 or just patch? It's opt-in by default.

Jamal: If it's opt-in and doesn't change existing behavior, patch. Minor only for a behavior change or new public API.

Release-bot: changelog-cutoff scheduled by @Sophie for 2026-03-18 12:00 UTC — add entries now or mark PR with `release-note/skip`.

Matt: I can own backports for `release/1.24`. Ping me on the PR. Quick submitter checklist: 1) one-liner, 2) PR number, 3) component(tag), 4) migration note if needed, 5) target branch.

Claire: tiny format nit — keep one-liners <=140 chars and start with `component(scope):` (helps the lint). :eyes: 

Jamal: If CI flags changelog format run: `./scripts/changelog-lint --fix` locally. If you can't fix in time, add label `changelog/fix` and mention me in the PR.

Sophie: Example one-liner (please copy the shape):

```
- routing(cache): Add in-memory prefix cache to reduce repeated KV hits (#3178)
```

Navin: Thanks — I'll update the PR, add `component(routing)`, and cc @Matt for the backport.

Release-bot: Reminder in 1h before cutoff (2026-03-18 11:00 UTC).

Claire: Thanks everyone — will scan the list at cutoff and nudge owners for any missing entries. :thumbsup:
